0022600206.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (6-3, 4-0 on the road, lost their last three) visit the Toronto Raptors (5-4, 2-1 at home, won their last game) in the 10th game of the Grizzlies' season, with Memphis 7th in the West and Toronto 5th in the East. Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart (out, knee bruise, averaging 11.9 points and 18.3 minutes) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness, averaging 6.4 points and 16.0 minutes), while Toronto is without Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Grizzlies lost both meetings in 2025-26, including the most recent one on April 3, 2026 in Memphis, a 128-96 Grizzlies loss.
